title: Topocode internal modules
summary: Thirteen private @topo/* runtime modules bundled by @jdylanmc/topo-code. Arrows are selected direct dependencies from package manifests, arranged as a readable composition spine, not a complete edge drawing or runtime call graph. Select a module for every declared incoming/outgoing internal dependency and its responsibility. Build-only eslint-config is excluded from this view; tooling and external context live in the companion map.
